mandate: C342 — test the cross-sectional intraday VOLUME-WEIGHTED RETURN SKEWNESS/KURTOSIS SEASONAL DISLOCATION statistical-arbitrage family on 10 USDT-M linear perps at native 5m (2592 pre-registered configs). Per-bar primitives: log_return=log(c[t]/c[t-1]) (r[0]=0) from real perp_close; notional real from C312. vw_ret_t=log_return_t*sqrt(notional_t) (NaN when notional<=0). Metrics over trailing lookback L bars ending at bar t-1: sample skewness and excess kurtosis of vw_ret. Seasonal baseline = trailing mean/std at same (weekday,tod) bucket from history strictly before bar t (causal shift(1)), min_periods=3, NaN-aware, excluding NaN obs. Signals: 4 real (skew_dev, kurt_dev, skew_z, kurt_z) + 4 placebos (phase-randomized surrogates, never edges). Single-leg dollar-neutral perp PnL with costs on turnover (taker=fee+slip; maker_blend=0.5*fee+slip). Gates: Holm+BH at alpha=0.05 (BOTH), MDE, stability, signal-vs-placebo attribution. PRE-REGISTERED NaN policy: metric NaN unless sufficient finite obs and valid denominators; seasonal stats NaN-aware min_periods excluding NaN obs; NaN-score bars weight 0; vw_ret NaN when notional<=0.

data_quality.note: metric NaN share dominated by finite-obs/denominator requirements plus zero-notional bars.

methodology.raw_features: log_return=log(c[t]/c[t-1]) (r[0]=0) from real strictly-positive perp_close; notional real from C312.
methodology.primitives: vw_ret_t=log_return_t*sqrt(notional_t) (NaN if notional<=0); skew_t=sample skewness of vw_ret over trailing L bars ending at t-1; kurt_t=sample excess kurtosis of vw_ret over same window, each NaN if std<=0 or insufficient finite obs.
methodology.signals: skew/kurt over trailing L bars ending at t-1; score=sign*(v-m)/sd with m/sd trailing same-bucket mean/std (min_periods=3, excluding NaN, causal shift(1)); cross-sectional rank, dollar-neutral gross 1.0; NaN-score assets weight 0.
methodology.pnl: single-leg perp: pnl = sum_i pos_i * perp_ret_i.
methodology.costs: charged on turnover; taker = fee+slip; maker_blend = 0.5*fee+slip.
methodology.missing_data: non-finite -> NaN; never impute/ffill; insufficient valid obs -> NaN -> not traded (fail-closed).
methodology.multiple_testing: one-sided paired t-test of per-split OOS net vs 0; Holm step-down AND Benjamini-Hochberg over all 2592 configs at alpha=0.05.
methodology.attribution: mean |OOS net| per signal across all its configs; shares=|mean|/sum(|means|) over all 8 signals incl. placebos; dominant must be a real (non-placebo) signal with share >= 0.5 for attribution_ok.
methodology.stability: sign consistency >= 0.70 of splits AND first/second-half Sharpe corr >= 0.5.
methodology.placebo: phase-randomized surrogate via FFT phase randomization + rank restoration to original marginal; deterministic seed recorded; same marginal distribution, destroyed temporal alignment.
